description.value: Overlay (midi-qol): offered as your reaction when a creature you can see within 60 feet casts a spell (a reaction about another creature: its condition reads subject) (midi's reaction trigger a creature within its range casts a spell, after the spell's slot is spent and before anything is rolled). The caster makes the Constitution save; on a failure its spell fails: no attack, save, damage or effects, and the spell slot it used isn't expended. Only the casting of a spell (tags.use.casts: not a Chromatic Orb leap, a chain's arc or a lingering area's turn) with Verbal, Somatic or Material components (its reaction condition reads the spell being cast).
